config.script:
id = self.view.params.id
	path = self.getSibling("Tree").props.selectionData[0].value.get('tag')
	
	if path == None:
		# Must be a folder selected.
		path = self.getSibling("Tree").props.selectionData[0].value.get('folder')
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage(messageType="tag-selection", payload={"id":id, "path":path})
	system.perspective.closePopup(id="tag-tree")
